header:
Awesome Cybersecurity Tools

> Open-source tools for scanning, monitoring, secrets, hardening and security learning. For defense and authorized testing. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Only test what you own or have written permission to test.**
- **Scanners give false positives.** Check findings by hand.
- **Keep tools updated.** Old signatures miss new threats.
- **Check the license.**

## Contributing
